description: This PHP script handles the deletion of test case scripts in the TestLink open source test management platform. It initializes environment variables, interacts with the database to delete records linking test cases and scripts, manages user rights, and renders a page to confirm or display the result of the deletion process.

methods.name: initEnv
methods.description: Initializes environment variables and objects needed for the script, including parsing request parameters and setting up UI components.

methods.name: getCodeTracker
methods.description: Retrieves the code tracker configuration and interface object for a given project ID.

methods.name: del_testcase_script
methods.description: Deletes the link between a test case version and its script in the database.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if the current user has the right to modify test cases, determining if the page can be viewed or actions can be performed.
